supplementaries.configuration.piston_twe.current_english: If true, adjacent pistons facing the same direction can pool their 12-block push budget to move structures larger than a single piston could handle alone (e.g. two side-by-side pistons pushing a 24-block slime contraption). If true, pushing an empty cauldron into a water or lava source (with a piston or a pulley) fills it with that fluid, instead of leaving it empty. Also tops up cauldrons being moved.

If true, pistons can push blocks that have a block entity (e.g. chests, furnaces). Blocks whose push reaction is BLOCK are still immovable regardless of this setting.
Quark takes priority here: while its 'pistons move tile entities' module is enabled this option does nothing and Quark handles piston moves instead, since the two implementations would otherwise both rebuild the moved block entity and wipe its contents. Turn that module off to use this one, which supports more cases (pulleys, cauldron filling, cooperative pistons).
Pulleys and ropes follow whichever implementation is active, so turning both off stops them from moving block entities too.

Wind vane animation swings according to this equation: 
pitch(time) = max_angle_1*sin(2pi*time*pow/period_1) + <max_angle_2>*sin(2pi*time*pow/<period_2>)
where:
 - pow = max(1,redstone_power*<power_scaling>)
 - time = time in ticks
 - redstone_power = block redstone power
<power_scaling> = how much frequency changes depending on power. 2 means it spins twice as fast each power level (2* for rain, 4* for thunder)
increase to have more distinct indication when weather changes

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.alex_tome.current_english: For those who can't settle with just a tiny hut.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.chems_tome.current_english: Smothers an area with runes that launch entities upward. Do NOT get covered in the Repulsion Runes.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.cocoaeyebrows_to.current_english: Leave the riches untouched. Seek only to carve the earth.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.darkfira_tome.current_english: Encases your enemies or friends in a tomb of ice. Guaranteed to leave them shocked and confused.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.farfalla_tome.current_english: Creates a fire that quickly freezes to ice.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.frantastic_tome.current_english: It is unknown whether the original author of this spell survived its first casting, or if she was replaced by one of her simulacra in the ensuing chaos. Don't think too hard about it.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.glow_tome.current_english: Snares the target and grants other targets Glowing.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.gootastic_tome.current_english: The squid's Lovecraftian roots appear to make it immune.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.ivy_tome.current_english: Now you never have to be lonely again! You will always have a friend with you! Feel free to change their name to whatever you want! :D

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.kamiihoney_tome.current_english: Safely contain your enemies while they wither away. Some say Kamii is still stuck in a bubble somewhere after miscasting this curse.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.kirin_tome.current_english: Heroes are so straightforward, so easily befuddled...

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.lufia_tome.current_english: Your enemies will try to kill you. Use this, to kill them back. Cast under a targets feet to bury them. Results may vary.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.mystifi_tome.current_english: Be careful About digging straight down, People say its like digging your own grave

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.nikk_tome.current_english: Weaken it, kill it and take it home.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.othy_tome.current_english: Swarm your enemies with bladed spirits.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.pandoxyy_tome.current_english: First you're airborne. Then you're dizzy. Then you're somewhere else. By the time you figure out what happened, it's already happening again.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.plauged757_tome.current_english: WARNING: ONLY TO BE USED AS A LAST RESORT!!

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.poseidon_tome.current_english: Fire at a body of water to create a Ice bubble in the depths.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.pranks_tome.current_english: Tome-Fuzzer sending chaotic magic streams into existence. May be hacking the planet.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.renew_rune_tome.current_english: Cures status effects and heals the user.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.riftderp_tome.current_english: Just like that one guy, from that one thing! This spell will put you right in the enemy's face, so be ready for some swordplay!

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.sebuss_tome.current_english: Even the book is burning hot! You might need to use this spell with caution if you don't want your item to burn!

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.shadow_tome.current_english: Creates a temporary tunnel of blocks.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.shoob_tome.current_english: Need a quick getaway? Using Shoob's patented "Tactical retreat" technique, you can escape AND do it gracefully! (Shibe Inc is not liable for misuse or failure in the escape)

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.silvanus_tome.current_english: When you want to go deeper but just don't have the torches

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.sloppybox_tome.current_english: Enough heat to melt a mountain or evaporate oceans.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.spinoftw_tome.current_english: A utility spell to aid you in your adventures

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.takeoff_tome.current_english: Launches the caster into the air and grants temporary elytra flight!

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.toxin_tome.current_english: Poisons that target and causes them to take additional damage from all sources.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.treeleafs_tome.current_english: Just make sure your somewhere you want to be greener

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.urticantodin_tom.current_english: Traveling issues? Nonsense, all it takes is one leap and you get there in no time! Why the sticky feeling? Safety precautions, your legs aren't strong enough for the sudden stop with the ground, so we made them bouncy!

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.vault_tome.current_english: Sometimes you just need to get over that wall.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.worsecookie_tome.current_english: Along the shore the cloud waves break, The twin suns sink beneath the lake, The shadows lengthen. In Carcosa

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.xacris_tome.current_english: Builds a small hut around the user.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.yeet_tome.current_english: Summons orbiting projectiles that will launch nearby enemies.

ars_nouveau.tome_flavor.yuukiukami_tome.current_english: One of YuukiUkami’s earliest creations, this spell reflects their desire for precision and mastery. minecolonies.quests.general.adayinthefie.current_english: Ah, perfect timing! I have been planning a field expedition with our university scholars to gather some rare medicinal herbs - there is a wonderful spot I know of not far from here. The trip out is easy enough, but I worry about getting everyone safely home before nightfall. The forest paths can be treacherous in the dark! I want to craft a Group Teleport Scroll to bring everyone home at once, but I am afraid I have used up all of my Teleport Scrolls on other projects. Could you bring me three?

minecolonies.quests.general.ancientmagic.current_english: Oh! Something extraordinary is happening - my crystals have been absolutely singing since you walked in. help.securitycraft.block_pocket_manager..baseline_english: The Block Pocket Manager is used to manage the Block Pocket, which is a room that only its owner and players on the allowlist can enter. When opening its GUI, you see a selection of sizes. Choose one, then build the Block Pocket around the manager. Make sure that the manager is placed on the outside of the bottom layer. The Block Pocket is a cube of the size you chose. The corners are built with Reinforced Chiseled Crystal Quartz, the blocks between the corners are built with correctly oriented Reinforced Crystal Quartz Pillars, and the floor/wall/ceiling is built with Block Pocket Walls. See this image for an example of how it looks: https://i.imgur.com/opc7dqO.png - Clicking "Activate" after the structure is built will activate any added modules. See the customization GUI for more information (rightclick with Universal Block Modifier).
help.securitycraft.block_pocket_manager..current_english: The Block Pocket Manager is used to manage the Block Pocket, which is a room that only its owner and players on the allowlist can enter. The Block Pocket has the shape of a cube and can have multiple sizes that can be selected through the block's GUI. After choosing a size, the structure can be built manually or auto-assembled if the necessary blocks are present. Make sure that the manager is placed on the outside of the bottom layer. The corners of the structure are built with Reinforced Chiseled Crystal Quartz, the edges are built with correctly oriented Reinforced Crystal Quartz Pillars, and the faces are filled in with Block Pocket Walls. Clicking "Activate" after the structure is built will activate it. After activation, only the owner and allowlisted players are able to enter the structure.

help.securitycraft.briefcase.info.baseline_english: The briefcase is a keypad-locked portable storage unit containing 12 slots. After crafting it, rightclick it to setup the 4-digit passcode to use from then on. Rightclick it again and insert the code to interact with the items. To remove a Briefcase's code or change its owner, put it into your offhand and rightclick while holding a Universal Key Changer/Universal Owner Changer in your mainhand.

To remove a Briefcase's code or change its owner, put it into your offhand and rightclick while holding a Universal Key Changer/Universal Owner Changer in your mainhand.
help.securitycraft.briefcase.info.installed_korean_candidate: 서류 가방은 12개의 슬롯이 들어 있는 키패드 잠금식 휴대용 저장장치입니다. 조작한 후 마우스 오른쪽을 클릭하여 그때부터 사용할 4자리 비밀번호가 설정됩니다. 다시 마우스 오른쪽을 누르고 항목과 상호 작용할 코드를 삽입합니다. 서류 가방의 코드를 제거하려면 만는 열쇠 변경기로 함께 만듭니다.
help.securitycraft.briefcase.info.project_output: 서류 가방은 암호로 잠기는 12칸짜리 휴대용 저장 장치입니다. 제작한 뒤 우클릭해 앞으로 사용할 4자리 암호를 설정하세요. 다시 우클릭해 암호를 입력하면 내용물을 사용할 수 있습니다. 암호를 없애거나 소유자를 바꾸려면 서류 가방을 보조 손에 들고, 주 손에 범용 열쇠 변경기 또는 범용 소유자 변경기를 든 채 우클릭하세요.

help.securitycraft.camera_monitor.info.baseline_english: The camera monitor is a portable item used to view live feeds of up to 30 bound security cameras. Right-click a security camera with the camera monitor to bind it, then right-click air and select the camera in the GUI while the camera's chunk is loaded to see its feed. Unbind a security camera by right-clicking it again with the camera monitor or by opening the camera monitor's GUI and clicking the corresponding "X" button.
help.securitycraft.camera_monitor.info.current_english: The camera monitor is a portable item used to view live feeds of up to 30 bound security cameras. Right-click a security camera with the camera monitor to bind it, then right-click air and select the camera in the GUI to see its feed. Unbind a security camera by right-clicking it again with the camera monitor or by opening the camera monitor's GUI and clicking the corresponding "X" button.
help.securitycraft.camera_monitor.info.installed_korean_candidate: 카메라 모니터는 최대 30대의 보안 카메라의 경계를 위해 실시간 피드를 볼 때 사용하는 휴대용 아이템입니다. 카메라 모니터가 있는 보안 카메라를 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭하여 바인딩한 다음, 허공를 마우스 오른쪽을 클릭하고 카메라 청크가 로드되어 있는 동안 GUI에서 카메라를 선택하여 피드를 확인합니다. 카메라 모니터로 다시 마우스 오른쪽을 클릭하거나 카메라 모니터의 GUI를 열고 해당 "X" 버튼을 클릭하여 보안 카메라 바인딩을 해제합니다.
help.securitycraft.camera_monitor.info.project_output: 카메라 모니터는 최대 30 바운드 보안 카메라의 라이브 피드를 보는 데 사용되는 휴대용 항목입니다. 카메라 모니터가 있는 보안 카메라를 우클릭하여 바인딩한 다음, 카메라 청크가 로드되는 동안 공기를 우클릭하고 GUI에서 카메라를 선택하여 피드를 확인합니다. 카메라 모니터에서 다시 우클릭하거나 카메라 모니터의 GUI를 열고 해당 "X" 버튼을 클릭하여 보안 카메라 바인딩을 해제합니다.

help.securitycraft.codebreaker.info.baseline_english: The codebreaker can crack any keycard reader, keypad, passcode-protected chest, passcode-protected barrel, or passcode-protected furnace's code by rightclicking on it. (5 uses with a 1/3 chance of it working)
help.securitycraft.codebreaker.info.current_english: The codebreaker can crack any keycard reader, keypad, passcode-protected chest, passcode-protected barrel, or passcode-protected furnace's code by rightclicking on it. The codebreaker has 5 uses with a 1/3 chance per use to successfully crack the code.
help.securitycraft.codebreaker.info.installed_korean_candidate: 코드브레이커는 키패드, 비밀번호로 보호된 상자 또는 비밀번호로 보호된 화로의 코드를 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭하여 깨트릴 수 있습니다. (5개 사용 시 1/3 확률로 사용)
help.securitycraft.codebreaker.info.project_output: 코드브레이커는 모든 키카드 판독기, 키패드, 암호로 보호된 상자, 암호로 보호된 통 또는 암호로 보호된 화로의 코드를 우클릭하여 해독할 수 있습니다. (5는 1/3와 함께 작동할 가능성이 있습니다)

help.securitycraft.inventory_scanner.inf.baseline_english: The inventory scanner is used by placing two scanners a block apart, facing each other. When placed correctly, a laser field should appear between them. Once they are placed, right-click either scanner to add prohibited items that should be detected. When a player walks between the scanners while carrying a prohibited item, different actions will be performed based on what modules are installed in the scanners.
help.securitycraft.inventory_scanner.inf.current_english: The inventory scanner is used by placing two scanners at most 2 blocks apart, facing each other. When placed correctly, a laser field should appear between them. Once they are placed, right-click either scanner to add prohibited items that should be detected. When a player walks between the scanners while carrying a prohibited item, different actions will be performed based on what modules are installed in the scanners.
help.securitycraft.inventory_scanner.inf.installed_korean_candidate: 인벤토리 감지기는 두 개의 감지기를 블록을 한 블록 간격으로 놓고 서로 마주보는 방식으로 사용됩니다. 올바르게 배치될 때 레이저 필드는 그 사이에 회전해야 합니다. 플레이어가 이 필드를 통과할 때, 감지기의 GUI에 있는 모든 블록이나 아이템은 감지기의 설정에 따라 삭제되거나 레드스톤 신호가 방출됩니다.
help.securitycraft.inventory_scanner.inf.project_output: 인벤토리 스캐너는 두 개의 스캐너를 한 블록 간격으로 서로 마주보게 배치하여 사용됩니다. 올바르게 배치되면 레이저 필드가 그 사이에 나타나야 합니다. 배치한 후에는 두 스캐너 중 하나를 우클릭하여 감지해야 하는 금지 항목을 추가하세요. 플레이어가 금지된 물건을 들고 스캐너 사이를 지나갈 때, 스캐너에 설치된 모듈에 따라 다른 작업이 수행됩니다.

help.securitycraft.keycard_reader.info.baseline_english: The keycard reader emits a 15-block redstone signal if you insert a keycard that matches with the reader's settings. You can configure the Keycard Reader by rightclicking it with anything other than a linked keycard. The signature is a number that links the reader and keycards together. Only keycards that have the same signature as the reader they were linked to will open said reader. Keycards linked to readers of other players will not work for your Keycard Readers. You can have multiple Keycard Readers with the same signature, and all your keycards with that signature will work on them as well. The keycard level buttons on the right side of the GUI are individual to each Keycard Reader and define which keycard levels can be used to activate this Keycard Reader.
help.securitycraft.keycard_reader.info.current_english: The keycard reader emits a redstone signal if you insert a keycard that matches with the reader's settings. You can configure the Keycard Reader by rightclicking it with anything other than a linked keycard. The signature is a number that links the reader and keycards together. Only keycards that have the same signature as the reader they were linked to will open said reader. Keycards linked to readers of other players will not work for your Keycard Readers. You can have multiple Keycard Readers with the same signature, and all your keycards with that signature will work on them as well. The keycard level buttons on the right side of the GUI are individual to each Keycard Reader and define which keycard levels can be used to activate this Keycard Reader.
help.securitycraft.keycard_reader.info.installed_korean_candidate: 판독기 설정과 일치하는 키카드를 삽입하면 키카드 판독기에서 15블록의 레드스톤 신호가 발생합니다. 연결된 키카드가 아닌 다른 키카드로 키카드 판독기를 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭하여 키카드 판독기를 구성할 수 있습니다. 서명은 판독기와 키카드를 함께 연결하는 번호입니다. 연결된 판독기와 동일한 서명을 가진 키카드만 해당 판독기를 엽니다. 다른 플레이어의 판독기에 연결된 키카드는 키카드 판독기에서 작동하지 않습니다. 동일한 서명을 가진 여러 개의 키카드 판독기를 가질 수 있으며, 해당 서명이 있는 모든 키카드도 이러한 키카드에서도 작동합니다. GUI 오른쪽에 있는 키카드 단계 버튼은 각 키카드 판독기마다 다르며 이 키카드 판독기를 활성화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 키카드 단계를 정의합니다.
help.securitycraft.keycard_reader.info.project_output: 리더의 설정과 일치하는 키카드를 삽입하면 키카드 리더는 15 블록 레드스톤 신호를 방출합니다. 연결된 키카드가 아닌 다른 항목을 우클릭하여 키카드 리더를 구성할 수 있습니다. 서명은 리더와 키카드를 연결하는 숫자입니다. 연결된 리더기와 동일한 서명이 있는 키카드만 해당 리더기를 열 수 있습니다. 다른 플레이어의 리더기에 연결된 키카드는 귀하의 키카드 리더기에서는 작동하지 않습니다. 동일한 서명이 있는 여러 개의 키카드 리더를 보유할 수 있으며 해당 서명이 있는 모든 키카드도 해당 리더에서 작동합니다. GUI 오른쪽에 있는 키카드 수준 버튼은 각 키카드 리더기에 개별적으로 적용되며 이 키카드 리더기를 활성화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 키카드 수준을 정의합니다.

help.securitycraft.keycards.info.baseline_english: Keycards can be linked to Keycard Readers in order to open them. To reset the settings on keycard, put it into a crafting table. See the Keycard Reader's manual page for more information.
help.securitycraft.keycards.info.current_english: Keycards can be linked to Keycard Readers in order to open them. To reset the settings of a keycard, put it into a crafting table. See the Keycard Reader's manual page for more information.
help.securitycraft.keycards.info.installed_korean_candidate: 키카드를 열기 위해 키카드 판독기에 연결할 수 있습니다. 키카드의 설정을 재설정하려면 제작대에 넣습니다. 자세한 내용은 키카드 판독기 설명서 페이지를 참조하십시오.
help.securitycraft.keycards.info.project_output: 키카드를 키카드 리더기에 연결하여 열 수 있습니다. 키카드의 설정을 재설정하려면 제작대에 넣으세요. 자세한 내용은 키카드 리더기의 매뉴얼 페이지를 참조하세요.

help.securitycraft.keypad.info.baseline_english: The keypad is used by placing the keypad, rightclicking it, and setting a numerical passcode. Once the keycode is set, rightclicking the keypad will allow you to enter the code. If it's correct, the keypad will emit redstone power for three seconds.
help.securitycraft.keypad.info.current_english: The keypad emits a redstone signal if a correct passcode is entered. Rightclicking a keypad after placing it down allows setting a numerical passcode. Once the passcode is set, rightclicking the keypad will allow you to enter the code.
help.securitycraft.keypad.info.installed_korean_candidate: 키패드는 키패드를 놓고 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭한 다음 숫자 비밀번호를 설정하는 방식으로 사용됩니다. 키코드가 설정되면 키패드를 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭하면 코드를 입력할 수 있습니다. 정확하면, 키패드는 3초 동안 레드스톤 전력을 방출할 것입니다.
help.securitycraft.keypad.info.project_output: 키패드는 키패드를 배치한 후 우클릭하고 숫자 암호를 설정하여 사용합니다. 키코드가 설정되면 키패드를 우클릭하면 코드를 입력할 수 있습니다. 그것이 맞다면 키패드는 3초 동안 레드스톤 전력을 방출합니다.

help.securitycraft.laser_block.info.baseline_english: The laser block is used by putting two of them within five blocks of each other. When the blocks are placed correctly, a laser should form between them.
help.securitycraft.laser_block.info.current_english: The laser block is used by putting two of them within five blocks of each other. When the blocks are placed correctly, a laser should form between them. When a player who is not the owner or allowlisted walks into such a laser, different actions will be performed based on what modules are installed in the laser blocks.
help.securitycraft.laser_block.info.installed_korean_candidate: 레이저 블록은 그 중 두 개를 서로 5블록 안에 넣어 사용합니다. 블록이 올바르게 배치되면, 레이저가 그 사이에 형성되어야 합니다.
help.securitycraft.laser_block.info.project_output: 레이저 블록은 5개 블록 내에 2개를 넣어서 사용합니다. 블록이 올바르게 배치되면 블록 사이에 레이저가 형성됩니다.

help.securitycraft.mine.info.baseline_english: The mine explodes when stepped on by any entity other than creepers, cats, and ocelots. Rightclicking the mine while holding wire cutters will defuse the mine and allow you to break it. Rightclicking with flint and steel equipped will re-enable it.
help.securitycraft.mine.info.current_english: The mine explodes when stepped on by any entity. Rightclicking the mine while holding wire cutters will defuse the mine and allow you to break it. Rightclicking with flint and steel equipped will re-enable it.
help.securitycraft.mine.info.installed_korean_candidate: 지뢰는 크리퍼, 고양이, 오셀롯 이외의 어떤 엔티티에 의해 밟히면 폭발합니다. 와이어 커터를 잡고 있는 동안 지뢰를 마우스 오른쪽 버튼으로 클릭하면 지뢰가 용해되어 지뢰를 부술 수 있습니다. 부싯돌과 부시를 장착한 상태에서 마우스 오른쪽 버튼을 클릭하면 다시 활성화됩니다.
help.securitycraft.mine.info.project_output: 지뢰는 크리퍼, 고양이, 오실롯을 제외한 개체가 밟으면 폭발합니다. 전선 절단기를 들고 지뢰를 우클릭하면 해체되어 안전하게 부술 수 있습니다. 부싯돌과 부시를 들고 우클릭하면 다시 활성화됩니다.

help.securitycraft.portable_radar.info.baseline_english: The portable radar will send the owner a chat message whenever a player is inside of the radar's detection radius (modifiable in the config file).
help.securitycraft.portable_radar.info.current_english: The portable radar will send the owner a chat message whenever a player is inside of the radar's detection radius (25 blocks by default, can be changed with the universal block modifier).
help.securitycraft.portable_radar.info.installed_korean_candidate: 휴대용 레이더는 플레이어가 레이더의 탐지 반경 내에 있을 때마다(구성 파일에서 수정할 수 있음) 소유자에게 채팅 메시지를 전송합니다.
help.securitycraft.portable_radar.info.project_output: 휴대용 레이더는 플레이어가 레이더의 감지 반경(구성 파일에서 수정 가능) 내에 있을 때마다 소유자에게 채팅 메시지를 보냅니다.

help.securitycraft.retinal_scanner.info.baseline_english: The retinal scanner emits a 15-block redstone signal when its owner hovers the cursor over it from any visible angle within breaking distance.
help.securitycraft.retinal_scanner.info.current_english: The retinal scanner emits a redstone signal when its owner hovers the cursor over it from any visible angle within breaking distance.
help.securitycraft.retinal_scanner.info.installed_korean_candidate: 망막 감지기는 소유자가 커서를 파단 거리 내의 가시 각도에서 커서를 위로 올릴 때 15블록의 레드스톤 신호를 발생합니다.
help.securitycraft.retinal_scanner.info.project_output: 망막 스캐너는 소유자가 차단 거리 내의 가시 각도에서 커서를 스캐너 위로 가져가면 15 블록 레드스톤 신호를 방출합니다.

help.securitycraft.secure_trading_statio.current_english: The secure trading station is used to trade items between players. Owners can configure the block to accept a certain amount of a maximum of 2 items as payment. If those items are submitted by a paying player, they are dispensed at the back side of the block, and a redstone signal will be emitted. If a storage module is inserted, the payment will instead be stored within the secure trading station, and owners can set a certain amount of a maximum of 2 items to be given as a reward to paying players, which are drawn from the block's inventory.

messages.securitycraft:keycard_acceptor..current_english: You are not authorized to use this keycard!
The owner of the Keycard Reader that this keycard was linked to does not match this block's owner!
This keycard does not have any uses left!
Keycards of level %s cannot be used on this block!
The signature saved on this keycard does not match this block's signature!

messages.securitycraft:secure_trading_st.current_english: The transaction could not be submitted due to missing payment items. Please supply more payment and try again.

module.securitycraft.secure_trading_stat.current_english: Adding a denylist module to a secure trading station will ban listed players from interacting with the block.
Adding a smart module to a secure trading station will make the station check for enchantments and other metadata when comparing whether the supplied payment equals the payment reference stacks.

Adding a storage module to a secure trading station will allow the block to store received payment items in its inventory. Additionally, the station will be able to give reward items to paying players, which are drawn from the block's inventory.
Adding an allowlist module to a secure trading station will allow listed players to submit transactions without needing to supply payment items.

module.securitycraft.username_logger.sma.current_english: Adding a smart module to a Username Logger will prevent the block from creating multiple entries for the same player by updating existing entries instead.

option.securitycraft.portable_radar.send.current_english: Should the radar send messages if players are in its radius?

securitycraft.configuration.more_perform.current_english: Should Secure Redstone Interfaces in "Receiver" mode be rendered without the spinning disk? This may lead to slight clientside performance gains.

securitycraft.configuration.owned_breaki.current_english:
How much slower it should be to break a block that is owned by the player breaking it.
The value is calculated as the normal block breaking speed divided by the owned block breaking slowdown. Example: A value of 2.0 means it takes twice as long to break the block.
This only applies when "Vanilla tool block breaking" is enabled.

securitycraft.configuration.reinforced_b.baseline_english: Set the color that reinforced blocks' textures have when reinforced_block_tint is enabled. This cannot be overridden by servers, and will be applied the same to all blocks. Grayscale values look best.
securitycraft.configuration.reinforced_b.current_english: Set the color that reinforced blocks' textures are tinted with. This will be applied the same to all blocks that satisfy the condition set by "reinforced_block_tint_mode". Grayscale values look best.
securitycraft.configuration.reinforced_b.project_output: 강화 블록 색조가 활성화되었을 때 강화 블록 텍스처의 색상을 설정합니다. 이는 서버에서 재정의할 수 없으며 모든 블록에 동일하게 적용됩니다. 그레이스케일 값이 가장 좋아 보입니다.

securitycraft.configuration.reinforced_b.current_english: Controls what condition placed reinforced blocks must satisfy in order to be colored compared to their vanilla counterparts. fancymenu.actions.blocks.add.delay.desc.baseline_english:
Adds a Delay block that waits for the specified time before running its contained actions.

The rest of the script keeps running while the delay counts down.
Delay time is in milliseconds.

Keep in mind the delay resets when the screen gets re-initialized (for example after resizing the window or closing and reopening the screen).

This is useful for timed sequences, cooldowns or spacing actions.
fancymenu.actions.blocks.add.delay.desc.current_english:
Adds a Delay Gate block. On the first reach, it starts a one-time timer and skips its contained actions. The surrounding script continues immediately.

This block does not schedule an execution. Its timer is checked only when the script reaches the same block instance again. Reaches before the timer expires skip the contained actions. The first reach at or after expiry opens the gate and runs them; every later reach runs them immediately.

Delay time is in milliseconds. A resolved delay of 0 or less, including invalid values, opens the gate immediately.

The gate resets only when that action-script instance is reconstructed or replaced.

Use Execute Later instead when every reach should schedule a fresh delayed execution.

fancymenu.placeholders.file_text.desc.baseline_english:
Reads text from a local file or remote URL and returns it.
Supports reading entire content or only the last few lines.

Content is cached to improve performance:
- Local files: Re-read every 1 second
- URLs: Re-read every 10 seconds

Required values:
- path_or_url: The file path or URL to read from
  Local files: Use relative paths (e.g. 'config/myfile.txt')
  Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/data.txt')
  
The file path can start with '.minecraft/' to target the default .minecraft directory.

Optional values:
- mode: How to read the content (default: 'all')
  Options: 'all' (entire content), 'last' (last X lines)
- separator: Text between lines when joining (default: '\n')
  Common options: '\n' (newline), ' | ', ', ', ' '
- last_lines: Number of lines to return in 'last' mode (default: 1)
  Only used when mode is 'last'

Note: When mode is 'last' with last_lines set to 1,
the single line is returned without any separator.

Returns empty string if source is not cached yet, doesn't exist,
cannot be read, or if there's no internet connection for URLs.

create_enchantment_industry.ponder.blaze.current_english: Automating with Mechanical Arms
In Extract Mode, two input Depots provide affixed equipment and a blank template
The input Arm recognizes each item's role for the selected mode and inserts it into the correct slot
Until both outputs are removed, neither the Arm nor a player can begin another batch
The output Arm extracts the stripped equipment and the filled template one after the other
Arms can also insert Apotheotic Essence containers and the Super activator; use a bottom pipe for continuous fluid supply
Introduction to Blaze Composer
The Blaze Composer transfers, combines, and reapplies Apotheosis affixes
Different affixes can also be collected together on the resulting template
Apply Mode consumes the template and adds or upgrades every compatible affix on the target equipment
Every output must be removed before the Composer will accept the next batch
Supply Apotheotic Essence through the bottom to activate Normal Mode
Normal Mode accepts Brass and Crystal Affix Templates; each tier has its own level capacity
Use the side panel to select Extract Mode...
...Merge Mode...
...or Apply Mode
Engineer's Goggles preview the required inputs, essence cost, result, and any reason an operation cannot start
Extract Mode moves one affix from equipment to a matching blank template and returns the equipment without that affix
Merge Mode combines templates of the same tier and rarity; two matching level 0.25 affixes produce level 0.5
Super Composing with Blaze Composer
Fill the Normal tank through the bottom pipe, then give the Composer a Godforged Pearl to permanently unlock its second tank
Keep the bottom pipe supplied after the unlock; once the Normal tank is full, more Apotheotic Essence flows into the second tank and activates Super Mode
Super Mode accepts only Apotheotic Affix Templates, which can carry levels beyond an affix's native limit
Actual level limits and essence costs follow server configuration; check them with Engineer's Goggles
With a clear path to the sky, an exposed nearby Lightning Rod safely redirects the strike with no penalty
Blocking the strike path prevents lightning, but the result randomly loses affix levels; Goggles show the possible loss range
With a clear sky but no Lightning Rod, the strike destroys the Composer before it can finish

book.eternal_starlight.nocturnal_millet.baseline_english:
Nocturnal Millet is a crop native to the Starlight Dimension, whose seeds are hidden within Thioquartz at the banks of the Ether River.
Nocturnal Millet seeds can be sown on dirt, farmland, or Dusted Gravel. Once the stalks have grown, the tops will naturally produce panicles.
When the panicles are plump and ripe, interacting with them will grant Nocturnal Millet. The stalks will remain after harvesting, but there is also a small probability that they will wither. Withered Nocturnal Millet will continuously destroy other types of crops nearby. If a stalk loses its vitality, applying bone meal can revive it.
If Nocturnal Millet is planted on Dusted Gravel and bone meal is applied to the stalk, the entire plant will enter a state of forgotten. Panicles in this state no longer produce ordinary Nocturnal Millet, but instead condense into Forgotten Nocturnal Millet. Plants in the forgotten state will seize the life force of other types of crops nearby to accelerate their own maturation. These types of panicles are exceptionally tough and can only be obtained by interacting with them. Destroying them with brute force will yield nothing.
book.eternal_starlight.nocturnal_millet.current_english:
Nocturnal Millet is a crop native to the Starlight Dimension, whose seeds are hidden within Thioquartz at the banks of the Ether River.
Nocturnal Millet seeds can be sown on dirt, farmland, or Dusted Gravel. Once the stalks have grown, the tops will naturally produce panicles.
When the panicles are plump and ripe, interacting with or destroying them will grant Nocturnal Millet. The stalks will remain after harvesting, but there is also a small probability that they will wither. Withered Nocturnal Millet will continuously destroy other types of crops nearby. If a stalk loses its vitality, applying bone meal can revive it.
If Nocturnal Millet is planted on Dusted Gravel and bone meal is applied to the stalk, the entire plant will enter a state of forgotten. Panicles in this state no longer produce ordinary Nocturnal Millet, but instead condense into Forgotten Nocturnal Millet. Plants in the forgotten state will seize the life force of other types of crops nearby to accelerate their own maturation.
book.eternal_starlight.nocturnal_millet.project_output:
야광 기장은 별빛 차원 토종 작물이며, 씨앗은 에테르 강둑의 티오쿼츠 속에 숨어 있습니다.
야광 기장 씨앗은 흙, 경작지 또는 가루 묻은 자갈에 심을 수 있습니다. 줄기가 자라면 꼭대기에 이삭이 자연스럽게 생깁니다.
이삭이 통통하게 익었을 때 상호작용하면 야광 기장을 얻습니다. 수확 뒤에도 줄기는 남지만 드물게 시들 수 있습니다. 시든 야광 기장은 주변의 다른 작물을 계속 파괴합니다. 줄기가 활력을 잃으면 뼛가루로 되살릴 수 있습니다.
가루 묻은 자갈에 심은 야광 기장 줄기에 뼛가루를 사용하면 식물 전체가 망각 상태에 들어갑니다. 이 상태의 이삭은 일반 야광 기장 대신 망각의 야광 기장을 응축합니다. 망각 상태의 식물은 주변 다른 작물의 생명력을 빼앗아 더 빨리 자랍니다. 이 이삭은 매우 질겨 상호작용해야만 얻을 수 있으며, 힘으로 부수면 아무것도 나오지 않습니다.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.arcan.current_english: The arrays catalogd in this chapter range from simple [#](8B0000)crafting arrays[#]() that reshape matter, to complex inscriptions that forge [#](4A0080)sigils[#](), bind [#](4A0080)sentient armor[#](), and even bend the passage of time. Master the fundamentals, and the rest shall follow.
The foundation of all vitaemantic craft, circles inscribed by the scribe's hand.

A second item placed becomes the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](). If both are valid, the array awakens and its working begins. Both components are [#](8B0000)consumed[#]() as the array activates; nothing remains but the result of the working.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Watch the pattern carefully when you place the base. If the glyph changes form, you are on the right path.[#]()

Before sigils, before rituals, before the great workings of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() were ever conceived, there was the [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Inscribed with the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#]() upon bare stone or earth, the array is the most fundamental expression of the art: a circle of intent, waiting to be given purpose.

To inscribe an array, hold the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#]() and press [Use] upon a solid surface. Each inscription consumes one charge; the tool holds twenty uses before wearing out.\
\
The empty array is inert. Click it with an item to place the [#](8B0000)base[#]() component. The design shifts if the base is recognized.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.craft.current_english: The simplest array, inscribe essence onto matter and reshape it.

Some crafting arrays require only common materials. Others demand reagents forged through more advanced means; the complexity of the product mirrors the complexity of the path to reach it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Most sigils, reagents, and bindings begin their existence within a crafting array. Master this foundation well.[#]()

[#](8B0000)Crafting Arrays[#]() are among the simplest expressions of the art. The array inscribes the essence of the [#](8B0000)base[#]() onto the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](), transmuting both into something new. A brief, elegant animation accompanies the transformation.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.defen.current_english: Wards that repel foes and deflect projectiles.

The Deflection Array requires an [#](8B0000)Tabula Animata[#]() and a diamond to inscribe, reflecting its advanced nature. It protects a column roughly 6 blocks tall and 3 blocks wide.\
\
The Repulsion Array needs only iron and lapis, making it accessible even to apprentice vitaemancers.\
\
[#](4A0080)The best defense is one your enemy never sees.[#]()

Where the Spike Array punishes intruders with pain, these arrays offer more sophisticated defenses.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Repulsion Array[#]() creates an invisible ward that pushes hostile creatures away in a 5-block radius. Anything that means you harm will find itself unable to approach.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Deflection Array[#]() projects a column of protective force above it, reflecting any projectile that passes through back the way it came.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.downg.current_english: The armor craves combat; starve it of violence, and it starves you.

The armor develops a bloodlust that seeps into your belly. If you fail to attack something recently, gnawing hunger overtakes you. Higher levels shorten the grace period and intensify the starvation.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor feeds on violence. Deny it, and it feeds on you instead.[#]()
Battle Hungry
Battle Hungry
The armor drags you down; water becomes a grave.

The armor grows dense and waterlogged, dragging you down through liquid like an anchor. Reduces swim speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The depths call, and the armor answers on your behalf.[#]()
Concrete Shoes
Concrete Shoes
The armor locks your off-hand; one arm must suffice.

The armor seizes your off-hand in a rigid grip, preventing you from using whatever you hold there. No torches, no shields, no secondary tools.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor demands your undivided attention.[#]()
Crippled Arm
Crippled Arm
The armor festers, choking your body's ability to heal.

The armor's living tissue sickens, suppressing your body's ability to mend. All healing is reduced by up to 80%%; a wound that should restore ten hearts barely returns two.\
\
[#](4A0080)What lives can also sicken.[#]()
Diseased
Diseased
The armor bleeds your strength; every strike lands softer.

The armor saps the force behind your strikes, blunting every blow. Reduces melee damage by up to 80%%.\

Dulled Blade

The armor drags at your arms; mining becomes a crawl.

The armor weighs upon your arms, making every swing of the pick feel like moving through tar. Reduces dig speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The stone mocks your feeble blows.[#]()
Leadened Pick
Leadened Pick
The armor hobbles your stride; each step heavier than the last.

The armor stiffens around your legs, hobbling your stride. Reduces movement speed by up to 70%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10\
\
[#](4A0080)Every step is a negotiation with the armor's weight.[#]()
Limp Leg
Limp Leg
The armor seals your throat; no potion shall pass your lips.

The armor rejects all liquid sustenance, clamping your throat shut against any potion you attempt to consume. No healing draughts, no buffs, no alchemical aids.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor alone shall sustain you, or so it believes.[#]()
Quenched
Quenched
The armor ruins your aim; every shot goes astray.

The armor interferes with your aim, introducing wild inaccuracy to every arrow and bolt you loose. Bows and crossbows become exercises in frustration.\
\
[#](4A0080)Your hands are steady. The armor is not.[#]()
Storm Trooper
Storm Trooper

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.envir.current_english: Arrays that command weather, growth, and frost.

The [#](8B0000)Freeze Array[#]() reaches out to nearby water sources and converts them to ice, while covering exposed solid ground in a thin layer of snow. The effect spreads in a 3-block radius.\
\
Once the array has frozen everything in reach, it dissipates.\
\
[#](4A0080)The vitaemancer's will made manifest in frost and bloom.[#]()

These arrays reshape the world around them.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Tempest Array[#]() commands the weather, toggling rain on or off at a cost of 500 EV from the owner's soul network. Like the time arrays, it is consumed on use.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Growth Array[#]() coaxes nearby crops and plants to grow faster in a 2-block radius, applying a gentle acceleration each second.

The [#](8B0000)Undertow Array[#]() is scribed with [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() and awakened by [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#](). Once active, it opens a [#](8B0000)vitaemantic current[#]() through the open column of air directly above the glyph, lifting or drowning any entity that enters, no water required.\
\
[#](8B0000)Right-click with an empty hand[#]() to reverse the flow. Upward currents push entities skyward; downward currents drag them to the bottom, mirroring a magma block's pull. The array is persistent and remembers its direction across world reloads.\
\
[#](8B0000)Scaling[#](): the strength of the current is read live from the array's own slots. Adding more [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() to the redstone slot strengthens the acceleration; adding more [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() to the kelp slot raises the terminal velocity. Simply right-click the array with additional ingredients to stack them into place.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Tip: the Arcane Scribe Tool can inscribe arrays directly into water source blocks, so an Undertow Array can still be placed at the bottom of a pool without draining it first.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.impri.current_english: Rebinds a monster spawner to a creature slain beside it.

The [#](8B0000)Array of Imprisonment[#]() binds a wandering soul into stone. Inscribe it directly atop a [#](8B0000)Monster Spawner[#](), then slay a creature within an [#](8B0000)11x11x11[#]() region centered on the array.\
\
The spawner forgets its old charge and takes on the dying creature's nature instead. The glyph, its purpose fulfilled, crumbles to nothing.

Pair it with a [#](4A0080)Torment Nexus[#]() to grow a captive harvest of whatever quarry you choose. Reconfiguring a spawner is a one-time rite: to change it again, inscribe a fresh array.\
\
A few mighty creatures are too willful to be bound and the array ignores their passing.\
\
[#](4A0080)What dies near the cage becomes the cage.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.liqui.current_english:
Neo Vitae brews its own [#](4A0080)Liquified Experience[#](), so the array needs nothing else installed to work.\
\
Should your world already hold another mod's experience fluid, name it in the server config under [#](8B0000)liquified_experience.preferred_fluid[#]() and the array will read and write that instead. The same section sets how many millibuckets a single point of experience is worth.
Drains Tomes of Peritia into a tank, or fills them back from one.

Learning is a fluid thing, and the [#](8B0000)Array of Liquified Experience[#]() proves it literally. Inscribe the glyph atop a chest and set a tank against it.\
\
Every [#](8B0000)Tome of Peritia[#]() resting in that chest is bled of what it holds, and the learning runs out as [#](4A0080)Liquified Experience[#]() into the waiting vessel.

The tank may sit against the array or against the chest itself; the glyph finds it either way. It works once a second and cares nothing for whether you are watching.\
\
Feed the array a [#](8B0000)redstone signal[#]() and the current runs backwards: the tank is drained and the tomes drink it back down.\
\
[#](4A0080)Knowledge poured out is knowledge that can be poured back.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.loyal.current_english: Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() using a [#](4A0080)Lead[#]() as the base reagent and a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#]() as the catalyst. Step near the active array to trigger the summoning. The nearest player within 8 blocks will be treated as the owner.
Summon and revive your tamed companions.

The [#](8B0000)Array of Loyal Friends[#]() is a powerful restorative circle that calls all of your tamed companions to your side. Any living pet within range will be teleported to the array and ordered to follow you.\
\
More remarkably, the array reaches beyond death itself. Fallen pets are restored to full health at the array's location, though they lose any items they were carrying. The array costs [#](4A0080)5,000 EV[#]() from your soul network.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.movem.current_english: Arrays of force, hurl creatures and objects with vitaemantic velocity.

A pair of arrays designed to hurl anything that crosses their threshold, players, creatures, loose items alike. One propels horizontally in the direction the entity faces; the other launches straight upward.

[#](8B0000)Speed Array[#](): Launches entities horizontally in the direction they face. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Updraft Array[#](): Hurls entities skyward with considerable force. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Useful for rapid transit systems, mob processing, or simply entertaining oneself at a guest's expense.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.redst.current_english: Arrays that interface with redstone mechanisms.

These arrays bridge the gap between vitaemancy and redstone engineering.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Signal Array[#]() outputs a redstone signal from 0 to 15, proportional to the Essentia Vitae stored in the owner's soul network. It scales linearly up to 1,000,000 EV. Requires a bound [#](8B0000)Arcane Ash[#]() to function.

The [#](8B0000)Trigger Array[#]() emits a brief redstone pulse whenever a mob or player steps on it. The pulse lasts half a second, long enough for any standard redstone mechanism to detect.\
\
It functions much like a pressure plate, but is nearly invisible once inscribed.\
\
[#](4A0080)The blood knows who walks above it.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.senti.current_english:
The [#](8B0000)Ritual of Binding[#](): [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base, an iron armor piece as catalyst.\
\
The armor is alive, and it watches everything you do. Be deliberate in what you teach it. [#](2E8B57)Hold sneak while examining a piece to see what it has learned so far.[#]()

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](), then apply the [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base. Place your [#](8B0000)Iron Helmet[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Chestplate[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Leggings[#](), or [#](8B0000)Iron Boots[#]() as catalyst, and step back.\
\
The armor begins equivalent to iron, but possesses 100 [#](B8860B)Upgrade Points[#]() that it will spend as it grows alongside you. There may be ways to surpass this limitation...
Armor that breathes, learns, and grows alongside its wearer.

To create [#](8B0000)Sentient Equipment[#](), you require [#](8B0000)Iron Armor[#](), the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#](), a [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#](), and at least a [#](8B0000)Common Spiritus Gem[#]() charged with sufficient [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). What emerges is no longer mere metal; it is alive, and it learns from you.

The [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Sentient Equipment[#]() rivals [#](B8860B)Diamond[#]() in resilience and can be repaired in an [#](8B0000)Anvil[#]() with additional [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]().
The armor learns from your deeds; guide its growth with care.

You have felt it, the armor shifting, adapting, straining to assist you in whatever task it observes. It grows in many directions at once, but its capacity is finite. Trying to master everything yields mastery of nothing.

Consider forging multiple sets, each trained for a specific purpose. A miner's set, a warrior's set, an explorer's set; specialization is the path to true power.\
\
You have devised [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() to assist with focused training, and another to imbue your armor with a greater capacity for growth.

The armor banks experience toward a skill each time you perform the deed that teaches it, and advances a level once enough has gathered.\
\
[#](B8860B)By magnitude[#](): skills tied to harm, healing, knowledge, or travel learn in proportion to the event, the damage taken or dealt, the health mended, the experience gathered, the distance crossed. Greater deeds teach it faster.

[#](B8860B)By repetition[#](): skills like mining, or enduring fire and venom, learn a fixed measure each time, one mark per block broken, or one for every moment wreathed in flame or coursing with poison.\
\
Each skill rises at its own thresholds. A [#](8B0000)few[#]() are never taught through deeds at all, but inscribed directly from a Tome.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.sigil.current_english: Command the wind to hurl you skyward, at your own peril.

The [#](8B0000)Air Sigil[#]() hurls you through the sky in whatever direction you face, trading 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() for each burst of momentum. The wind obeys, but gravity does not; this sigil offers no protection from the landing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)More than one overconfident apprentice has drained their [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() mid-flight. Know your reserves before you leap.[#]()
Air Sigil
Air Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Air Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The sky remembers every mage who forgot to look down.[#]()

The sigil remembers a [#](8B0000)brightness level[#]() from 1 to 15. Left-click the air to cycle the brightness upward. Sneak and left-click to cycle it downward. The current setting is shown in the sigil's tooltip.\
\
Once a blood light has been placed, you can also adjust it directly. Right-click an existing blood light with an empty hand to increase its brightness, or sneak and right-click to dim it.
Brightness Control
Cast colored motes of blood-light into the darkness ahead of you.

Blood lights are not limited to their natural crimson. Combine the sigil with any vanilla [#](8B0000)dye[#]() in a shapeless craft to change its color. All other data on the sigil, including its binding and brightness setting, is preserved.\
\
Lights placed after dyeing will glow in the chosen color. To restore the default red, simply place the sigil alone in a crafting grid.
Color Dyeing

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Blood Lamp[#]() launches a mote of crystallized [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() in the direction you face. When it strikes a surface, it anchors itself as a permanent floating light source at a cost of merely 10 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, right-clicking a nearby surface places the light directly without launching a projectile.
Sigil of the Blood Lamp
Sigil of the Blood Lamp

Forge the [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)A small light to banish the deepest dark, in any color you desire.[#]()

Right-click a blood light with [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() to toggle redstone sensitivity. When enabled, the light will only emit light and particles while receiving a redstone signal. Without a signal, it goes dark.\
\
Right-click with redstone again to disable redstone control and return the light to its always-on state.
Redstone Control
Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with an [#](4A0080)Eye of Ender[#]() as the base and an [#](4A0080)Tabula Animata[#]() as the catalyst.
Crafting
Access a linked container from anywhere in the world.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Bound Treasures[#]() links to a container and allows you to access its contents from anywhere. [#](8B0000)Shift right-click[#]() a chest, barrel, or any other container to bind it to the sigil. Then [#](8B0000)right-click[#]() in the air to open the linked container remotely at a cost of [#](4A0080)200 EV[#]().\
\
The linked container must be in a loaded chunk to be accessed. If the container is destroyed, the link is broken.
Sigil of Bound Treasures
Sigil of Bound Treasures

Sigils fall into two schools of invocation:

- [#](8B0000)Use-on-cast[#]() sigils such as the [#](8B0000)Water[#](), [#](8B0000)Lava[#](), [#](8B0000)Void[#](), and [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Sigils[#]() perform a single act each time you invoke them, drawing a fixed measure of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per use.

- [#](8B0000)Toggleable[#]() sigils maintain a continuous effect while held active. They draw [#](4A0080)EV[#]() at a steady upkeep so long as their power flows.
Sigil Activation

The toggleable sigils are:

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Green Grove[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Miner[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of Magnetism[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Frozen Lake[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of Suppression[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Bridge[#]()

To toggle a sigil on or off, hold [#](8B0000)Shift[#]() and right-click into open air. Aiming at a block or creature will perform that sigil's normal action instead, so the shift requirement protects against accidental toggles in the heat of work.

An active toggleable sigil bears a faint enchantment shimmer, and its tooltip lists the [#](4A0080)EV[#]() it drains per interval. When your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() runs dry, the sigil quietly deactivates until you refill and reignite it.
A lens into the unseen, reveals the state of your Anima and Ara Vitae.

Hold sneak and press [Use] to open a configuration interface. Here you may reposition the various [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() display elements on your field of vision. Click and drag to move them, then select Save to preserve the arrangement, or Default to restore the original positions.

The configurable displays are:

- The Incense Altar (light gray)

- The Seer's Sigil (purple)

- The Divination Sigil (lavender)

- The Spiritus Aura Gauge (orange)

- The Sigil of Holding (green)

Press [#](4A0080)H[#]() (rebindable under Controls) to drag each display where you like.

The [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() is the first lens through which a Vitaemancer peers into the invisible currents of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() that sustain all vitaemantic works. Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from humble components, it reveals what the naked eye cannot.
Divination Sigil
Divination Sigil

Inscribe the array with [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() as the base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() as the catalyst. The sigil that emerges thrums faintly with awareness.\
\
[#](4A0080)To see is to begin understanding.[#]()

The sigil serves two vital purposes:

- Activate it toward open air to reveal the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() stored within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), the measure of your reserves.

- Aim it at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to reveal the altar's current tier, the volume of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within, and its maximum capacity.
Feed life into the soil and watch the world bloom around you.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Green Grove[#]() channels [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into the living earth, coaxing plants to grow with unnatural speed. A marriage of blood and botany that any practitioner with a garden will find indispensable.
Sigil of the Green Grove
Sigil of the Green Grove
Forge the [#](8B0000)Growth Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Robur[#]() as catalyst.

Aim at a growable block and press [Use] to apply a burst of growth for 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle a persistent aura. While active, every block within a 7x7x5 volume centered on you receives a growth pulse every 5 seconds, at a cost of 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per cycle.
Carry five sigils in one, their power at your fingertips.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Holding[#]() is a vessel within a vessel, capable of containing up to five other [#](8B0000)Sigils[#]() simultaneously. While held, it channels their passive effects and allows you to activate any of them at will.\
\
Press the Open Holding keybind to access its inventory. Use the cycle keybinds or hold sneak and scroll to switch between stored sigils.
Sigil of Holding
Sigil of Holding

Forge the [#](8B0000)Holding Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)One hand to hold the world's power.[#]()
Walk upon water made solid by the chill of your Anima.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Frozen Lake[#]() chills the water beneath your feet as you walk, crystallizing it into solid ice within a two-block radius. The effect is reminiscent of ancient frost enchantments, but drawn from [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() rather than arcane inscriptions.\
\
Toggle it with sneak and [Use]. The ice endures only as long as you remain near.
Sigil of the Frozen Lake
Sigil of the Frozen Lake
Summon molten stone at a steep cost to your Anima.

Sister to the [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#](), the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() draws molten stone from the depths of your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() at a cost of 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The price reflects the violence of the element, and if your reserves cannot bear it, five hearts are torn from your flesh instead.
Lava Sigil
Lava Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Lava Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)Handle with the reverence due to hellfire.[#]()

Like its cooler counterpart, the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() may serve as a component in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() to automate the production of [#](8B0000)Lava Buckets[#](). The sigil is not consumed.
Extend your reach; items drift toward you unbidden.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Magnetism[#]() bends the subtle forces between you and nearby objects, extending your item pickup range to 7 blocks while active. Hold the sigil, then hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle the effect.\
\
The sigil drains 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while its pull persists.
Sigil of Magnetism
Sigil of Magnetism

Forge the [#](8B0000)Magnetism Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The world draws near to those who command it.[#]()
Blood-fueled haste for those who delve deep.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Miner[#]() infuses your muscles with vitaemantic vigor, granting the Haste effect while active. Stone yields faster, timber falls quicker, earth parts more readily.\
\
Toggle with sneak and [Use]. Drains 100 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while the effect persists.
Sigil of the Fast Miner
Sigil of the Fast Miner

Forge the [#](8B0000)Mining Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Robur[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The earth parts before the blood-quickened hand.[#]()

Summoned undead are loyal to their creator. They will follow you when idle and automatically attack whatever target you last struck. They cannot harm their master, drop no loot or experience, and are immune to sunlight.\
\
To dismiss a servant early, [#](8B0000)shift right-click[#]() it while holding the sigil.
Servant Behavior

Unlike most sigils, the [#](8B0000)Sigil of Necromancy[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() rather than inscribed via alchemy array. Place a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#](), [#](4A0080)Rotten Flesh[#](), and [#](4A0080)Bone[#]() in the input slots with a [#](8B0000)Resonator[#]() tool. Supply [#](4A0080)1,000 mB of Essentia Vitae[#]() and a minimum of [#](8B0000)20 Raw Spiritus[#]().
Crafting
Raise undead servants to fight alongside you.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Necromancy[#]() calls upon the latent death in the world to raise an [#](4A0080)Undead Servant[#]() at the location you are aiming. Each use costs [#](4A0080)2,000 EV[#]() and summons one of four undead variants at random: a zombie, husk, skeleton, or stray.\
\
Servants last for 5 minutes before crumbling to dust, and will disappear if they stray too far from their master.
Sigil of Necromancy
Sigil of Necromancy
Walk upon crystallized EV, a bridge born of blood beneath your feet.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Bridge[#]() crystallizes [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into temporary platforms beneath your feet as you walk. These spectral surfaces allow you to traverse chasms, voids, and open sky with the confidence of solid ground.\
\
The phantom blocks dissolve shortly after you leave them behind. [#](2E8B57)Keep moving; hesitation over the abyss is unwise.[#]()
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge

Forge the [#](8B0000)Phantom Bridge Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)Between you and the void, blood is the only bridge you need.[#]()
A deeper sight, reveals the full workings of the Ara Vitae.

When aimed at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), the Seer's display reveals, from top to bottom:

- The altar's current [#](B8860B)Tier[#]()

- Current [#](4A0080)EV[#]() volume and total capacity

- Active crafting progress, if any

- [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() consumed per tick during crafting

- Current [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() reserve held by Charging Runes

Where the [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() offers a glimpse, the [#](8B0000)Seer's Sigil[#]() opens your perception wide. It reveals not only the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), but lays bare the inner workings of the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() itself , crafting progress, consumption rates, and more.\
\
It also provides the same display configuration as its lesser counterpart.
Seer's Sigil
Seer's Sigil

First, forge the [#](8B0000)Sight Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](). Then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)When mere sight is no longer sufficient.[#]()

The Seer also lays bare the reach of your [#](4A0080)rituals[#](). Look upon an active [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() and the ritual's working area is traced in the world, a colored boundary drawn around each of its ranges, exactly the zones the [#](8B0000)Ritual Configurator[#]() defines.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The sigil need only be on your person: in your pack, tucked within a Sigil of Holding, or worn as a charm.[#]()
Command the elements to part; fluid yields to your presence.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Suppression[#]() exerts your will upon the elements themselves, temporarily banishing all fluids within roughly six blocks of you. The liquid vanishes as though it never existed, returning only after you move away.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A powerful tool for traversing Nether lava oceans. But be wary of deep water; deactivating above a chasm invites a swift end.[#]()
Sigil of Suppression
Sigil of Suppression

Forge the [#](8B0000)Suppression Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The elements themselves bow before sufficient will.[#]()
Tear through space itself to reach a bound Teleposer.

The [#](8B0000)Teleposition Sigil[#]() tears a momentary rift between you and a linked [#](8B0000)Teleposer[#](), pulling you across any distance, even between dimensions, for 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Sneak-click on a [#](8B0000)Teleposer[#]() to bind its location to the sigil. [#](2E8B57)Do not move the Teleposer afterward, or you may find yourself arriving somewhere... unexpected.[#]()
Teleposition Sigil
Teleposition Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Teleposition Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The distance between here and there is merely a matter of blood.[#]()
Erase fluid from existence with a single gesture.

The [#](8B0000)Void Sigil[#]() annihilates fluid on contact, consuming 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per block erased. Aim at any liquid and press [Use] to watch it vanish without a trace.\
\
Invaluable for clearing treacherous lava flows or unwanted floods without the tedium of conventional methods.
Void Sigil
Void Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Void Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)What the void takes, it does not return.[#]()
Conjure water from the currents of your Anima.

The [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() conjures a source of water from nothing, drawn from the currents of your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() at a cost of 100 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per use. Aim at any solid surface and press [Use].\
\
Should your reserves prove insufficient, the sigil draws the toll from your own blood instead.
Water Sigil
Water Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Water Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)An endless spring, born of sacrifice.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() may also serve as a component in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), automating the production of [#](8B0000)Water Buckets[#](). The sigil itself is not consumed in this process.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.spike.current_english: An invisible ward that punishes those who tread upon it.

The [#](8B0000)Spike Array[#]() is a cruel but effective ward. Any living creature that steps onto it suffers a full heart of damage. The array is nearly invisible once inscribed, making it ideal for defending passages or feeding certain... automated arrangements.

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() and apply the appropriate base and catalyst to form the spike glyph.\
\
[#](4A0080)The floor remembers every trespass.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.spiri.current_english: A trap that damages mobs and harvests raw spiritus.

Requires an [#](8B0000)Tabula Animata[#]() to inscribe, reflecting the deeper understanding of spiritual energy needed to harness it.\
\
Each activation releases 0.5 units of raw (default) spiritus into the chunk. Players are immune to its effects.\
\
[#](4A0080)Every creature carries a spark of will. This array simply... liberates it.[#]()

This array combines the cruelty of the Spike Array with a deeper purpose. When a non-player creature steps onto it, the array inflicts a full heart of damage and extracts a fragment of raw [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the act of suffering, releasing it into the surrounding chunk.\
\
The array has a brief cooldown between activations to prevent overwhelming the local aura with too much spiritus at once.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.telep.current_english: A vertical transit glyph that folds space between aligned arrays.

Multiple arrays can be chained vertically to create a multi-floor elevator shaft. Each array searches only along the same X/Z column, so they must be precisely aligned.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Place one at the bottom of your base and one at the top for instant vertical transit. Add intermediate floors as needed, each jump or sneak moves you to the nearest array, not the furthest.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Teleposition Array[#]() folds space between two aligned glyphs, creating a seamless vertical transit system. A single array does nothing on its own you must place [#](8B0000)at least two[#]() arrays directly above one another, aligned on the same block column, at any distance up to [#](B8860B)64 blocks[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Jump[#]() while standing on an array to teleport upward to the next array above. [#](B8860B)Sneak[#]() to descend to the nearest array below.

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.time_.current_english: Bend the sky's clock, summon dawn or hasten dusk.

Among the most audacious workings in [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() are these arrays that bend the passage of time itself. Once activated, the inscribed components are consumed as the sky obeys.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Day[#]() array advances the world to the next sunrise. The [#](8B0000)Night[#]() array draws it forward to the next sunset.

[#](8B0000)New Dawn[#](): Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Commands the sun to rise.\
\
[#](8B0000)True Twilight[#](): Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Beckons the fall of night.\
\
[#](4A0080)Time is not yours to own, only to borrow.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.train.current_english: A focus of discipline, control what your sentient armor learns.

The armor's undirected growth can be maddening. To impose order upon it, you have devised the [#](8B0000)Training Bracelet[#](), a focus that allows you to dictate which abilities the armor should pursue and which it should ignore.\
\
Press [Use] to open its configuration menu.

The [#](8B0000)Training Bracelet[#]() is forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
Only one bracelet is active at a time. Priority order: off-hand, Curios slots (if available), main inventory, then any add-on inventories.

With a copy of the relevant [#](8B0000)Tome[#]() in hand, you can set a level cap for any upgrade. Once the armor reaches that limit, it ceases training that skill.\
\
[#](2E8B57)To allow all upgrades except one: set the bracelet to 'allow others' mode and cap the unwanted skill at level 0.[#]()

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.upgra.current_english: Feed yourself well and the armor fortifies your body in turn.

The armor observes your habits of nourishment and responds in kind, hardening your frame against impact. Grants an [#](4A0080)anchored stance[#]() that resists being thrown and bolsters your vitality considerably.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Eating food.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Body Builder
Body Builder
Inscribe knowledge upon tomes, and the armor crystallizes into diamond-like hardness.

The armor responds to the knowledge you inscribe upon [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tomes[#](), hardening its lattice with each lesson. Grants up to +5 [#](4A0080)Armor[#]() and +10 [#](4A0080)Toughness[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Inscribe a [#](8B0000)Brilliance Tome[#]() in the Tabula Vitae, then apply it to Living Armor. Each tome grants 1 level, up to a maximum of 6.
Brilliance
Brilliance
Your momentum becomes a weapon; the faster you charge, the harder you strike.

The armor learns to channel your momentum into devastating force. Sprinting attacks deal increased damage and knockback, up to +50%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Dealing damage while sprinting.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Charging Strike
Charging Strike
The armor grows sockets to hold your vitaemantic trinkets.

The armor opens hidden recesses within itself, forming [#](8B0000)Sentient Armor Socket[#]() slots that can hold compatible [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() trinkets.\
\
This upgrade cannot be trained; only inscribed via [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tome[#](). Each tome adds one additional socket.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires the Curios API.[#]()
Socketed
Socketed
The deeper you dig, the faster the armor drives your arms.

The armor recognizes the rhythm of the pick. Mining identical blocks in succession accelerates your speed, and at higher levels a surge of [#](4A0080)Haste[#]() follows each broken block.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Mining blocks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Dwarven Might
Dwarven Might
Wings of living tissue unfurl from the chestplate, take to the sky.

The armor sprouts membranes of living tissue, granting true flight. This upgrade cannot be trained; it must be inscribed via [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tome[#]().\
\
The wings draw upon the chestplate's vitality, wearing it down at half the rate of conventional elytra. The aesthetic is, admittedly, rather striking.
Elytra
Elytra

The [#](8B0000)Elytra Tome[#]() is forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Apply it to your [#](8B0000)Sentient Chestplate[#]() to unfurl the wings.\
\
[#](4A0080)Blood gave you life. Now it gives you the sky.[#]()
The armor draws deeper knowledge from each fallen foe.

The armor learns to amplify the resonance of slain creatures, drawing forth greater experience from each kill. Increases XP drops up to 150%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Collecting experience orbs.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Experienced
Experienced
Each blow teaches the armor to sharpen the next.

The armor studies each blow you deliver and sharpens your killing edge in response. Melee attacks deal progressively greater damage.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Performing melee attacks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Fierce Strike
Fierce Strike
The armor remembers the flame and learns to refuse it.

The armor absorbs the memory of flame and learns to shield you from it. Grants [#](4A0080)Fire Resistance[#](). Higher levels extend the duration and reduce the cooldown between activations.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Being on fire. [#](2E8B57)A Potion of Fire Resistance is highly recommended during training.[#]()\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Gift of Ignis
Gift of Ignis
A golden sheen earns the Piglins' grudging respect.

The armor takes on a subtle golden sheen, marking you as an ally to the Piglins of the Nether. They regard you as they would any creature wearing gold.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Handing a [#](8B0000)Gold Ingot[#]() directly to a Piglin. It must be given by hand, not dropped.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 1
Gilded
Gilded
Every wound healed teaches the armor to strengthen your life force.

The armor learns from each wound mended and expands your vitality in turn, greatly increasing the amount of punishment your body can endure.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Restoring health through any means, natural regeneration, potions, or vitaemantic healing.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Healthy
Healthy
Every arrow absorbed teaches the armor to blunt the next.

The armor hardens against projectile impacts, blunting the force of arrows and other ranged attacks. Each level absorbs more of the blow, reducing incoming projectile damage by up to [#](4A0080)80%%[#]() at maximum.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Being struck by projectiles.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Pin Cushion
Pin Cushion
The armor learns to purge venom from your blood.

The armor develops an antivenom response, automatically purging Poison from your blood. Higher levels shorten the cooldown between cures.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Being poisoned.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Poison Resistance
Poison Resistance
The armor quickens your step with every mile traveled.

The armor attunes itself to the cadence of your stride, propelling you ever faster. Increases movement speed up to 150%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Running.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Quick Feet
Quick Feet
The armor knits its own wounds shut, slowly restoring worn equipment.

The armor develops a regenerative instinct, periodically mending a random piece of worn equipment every 100 ticks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Repairing the chestplate through any means, anvil, [#](8B0000)Mending[#]() enchantment, or otherwise.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 1
Repair
Repair
The armor learns to absorb impact; the ground softens beneath you.

The armor absorbs the shock of descent, cushioning your landing with increasing skill. At its peak, fall damage is negated entirely.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Suffering fall damage.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Soft Fall
Soft Fall
The armor coils like a spring beneath you, launching you skyward.

The armor amplifies the power of your legs, propelling you higher with each leap. Grants up to 7.5 additional blocks of jump height and 83%% fall resistance.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Hold sneak while jumping to suppress the boost.[#]()\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Jumping.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Strong Legs
Strong Legs

The [#](4A0080)Tome[#]() is consumed in the process, transferring all stored experience to the chestplate. If insufficient [#](B8860B)Upgrade Points[#]() remain, the tome applies what it can and retains the rest, unless less than one level's worth remains, in which case the tome crumbles to nothing.
Crystallized knowledge, inscribe specific skills onto your sentient armor.

[#](4A0080)Upgrade Tomes[#]() are crystallized records of a particular skill, each carrying the experience needed to inscribe one or more levels of its upgrade onto a chestplate. They come from several places:\
\
- The loot tables of [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() (ore chambers, the Smithy, Foreman's hoard).

- The [#](8B0000)Sentient Extraction[#]() ritual, which extracts the upgrades from a thrown sentient armor piece as tomes.

- Combining two tomes of the same upgrade at a vanilla crafting table.

- Inscribing select tomes, such as [#](8B0000)Brilliance[#]() and [#](8B0000)Curios Sockets[#](), in the Tabula Vitae.\
\
Press [Use] while holding a tome to inscribe one level of that skill onto your worn chestplate, assuming sufficient [#](B8860B)Upgrade Points[#]() remain. Hold sneak and press [Use] to inscribe as much as possible at once.
Upgrade Tomes
Upgrade Tomes

Tomes are the key to deliberate specialization. Focus your training on the abilities that serve you best, and discard the rest.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Consider maintaining separate chestplates for different purposes, one for mining, another for combat, a third for exploration. Each can be trained with its own set of tomes.[#]()
Pain is the teacher; each blow hardens the armor's resolve.

The armor hardens against melee strikes, explosions, and all forms of close-range violence. Protection against non-projectile harm increases with each wound endured.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Taking damage from sources other than projectiles.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Tough
Tough
Calloused hands yield more Essentia Vitae with each sacrifice.

The armor toughens your hands against the bite of the sacrificial blade, yielding more [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from each offering. Grants up to 150%% bonus to self-sacrifice.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Bleeding into your [#](8B0000)Orb of Vitae[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Tough Palms
Tough Palms

book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.utili.current_english: Practical arrays for collection, light, and smelting.

The [#](8B0000)Endless Fountain Array[#]() is scribed with a [#](8B0000)Block of Lapis[#]() and awakened by a [#](8B0000)Sea Pickle[#](). Once lit, it draws water from nowhere and pipes it into every fluid container touching its six faces.\
\
Each placement cycle (every 5 ticks) the array attempts to deposit [#](8B0000)up to 6 buckets[#]() of water, spread evenly across its neighbors (one per face when all six are tanks). Only whole-bucket fills are committed: if a tank has room for less than a full bucket the array skips it and tries the next cached neighbor until all 6 buckets land or every tank refuses.

The array keeps a cache of its six adjacent tanks. The cache refreshes on a timer and also reacts instantly whenever a neighboring block is placed or broken, so tanks can be swapped in or out freely without waiting for the next scan. Neighbors in unloaded chunks are left alone until their chunk ticks in again.\
\
When every cached tank is full the array backs off progressively (like the [#](8B0000)Serenade of the Nether[#]()). While backing off it emits a small puff of drowsy slate-gray particles so you can spot a stalled fountain at a glance; the moment a tank opens up it snaps back to full cadence.\
\
A [#](8B0000)redstone signal[#]() on any face parks the array completely, preserving its cache and backoff state, making it easy to gate with a lever or comparator.

The [#](8B0000)Furnace Array[#]() transmutes raw materials dropped nearby into their smelted forms, following standard furnace recipes. It costs 10 EV per stack smelted from the owner's soul network, and items within its radius will not despawn while awaiting processing.\
\
Cook time matches a standard furnace, but the array processes all valid stacks simultaneously.\
\
[#](4A0080)The floor itself becomes the forge.[#]()

Not all arrays are weapons. These workings serve the practical needs of a vitaemancer's workshop.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Collection Array[#]() draws dropped items within 2 blocks toward its center. Place it atop a chest and collected items will be deposited directly inside.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Light Array[#]() radiates illumination from invisible sources above the array, keeping an area well-lit without cluttering it with torches.

The [#](8B0000)Light Array[#]() hangs [#](8B0000)25[#]() invisible lights in the air above itself, filling every open space within [#](8B0000)3[#]() blocks of the array in a diamond. Each burns at full strength, so the whole span is lit as brightly as daylight.\
\
